rationale: Hold, with the horizon extended a week: nothing planned changes in substance. Week 1 (12-18 Oct) is firm; weeks 2-3 are provisional, and 26 Oct-1 Nov is new (a post-Stroud easy week into Guy Fawkes). One small change: the 17 Oct 2x15 threshold target moves from 3:52-3:55 to 3:50-3:53, because 10 Oct ran 3:47-3:49 at RPE 6 against 3:52-3:55. That was the only clean qualifier: the 30 Sep one was a 200m session at RPE 2, so the pace_target flag rests on thin evidence. The 14 Oct reps stay at 3:38-3:40. HRV is back to 41 BALANCED, so the gate that shaped last week has cleared.

changes.notes: Rest. Normal Monday after the 15 km long run.

Easy 8km, conversational, Nike Vomero Plus. Optional slot for a first Alphafly 2 outing if you want to start the trial (see the 9 Oct reply): 5-6 km easy, no strides, then check achilles score and first-step stiffness next morning. Skip it if the hamstring is still tight.

5x1km at 3:38-3:40/km, 90s jog recovery, 3km warm-up and 3km cool-down, ~12.5km all in, Endorphin Speed 5. Purpose: race-specific VO2/economy at 5-mile pace (record 3:38/km), supports the 10K too. Feel: hard but controlled. Recovery cost ~2 days. Progression: one more rep than 4x1km on 7 Oct, same prescribed pace; that session came in 3:36, 2-4 s inside, so hold the range and do not run under it. HRV is back to 41 BALANCED. Gate: hamstring tight in the warm-up or on rep 1 = stop at 4 reps. Chest symptoms or a temperature = easy run instead.
Easy 7km. Leg gym fits here (calf, soleus, single-leg, RDL), clear of Saturday by 48h.
Easy 6km.

3km warm-up, 2x15min at threshold (3:50-3:53/km) with 3 min jog, 3km cool-down, ~13km all in. Purpose: lactate threshold, aerobic-dominant. Progression: longer reps than 3x8; pace tightened 2 s from 3:52-3:55 because 10 Oct ran 3:47-3:49 at RPE 6 (aimed for 'around 3:50' from memory, so not a deliberate overrun). A modest step; run it on pace, not under. Feel is an observation, not a target.
Long run 16km genuinely easy (~5:00/km or slower). One gel at ~40 min for practice. No pace work. Last long run before Stroud; keep it unremarkable.
Provisional — Rest. Race week opens with the normal Monday.
Provisional — Easy 8km, conversational.

Provisional — Last sharpener, 4 days before Stroud: 3km warm-up, 6x600m at 3:32-3:36/km with 2 min jog, 3km cool-down, ~11.5km all in. Purpose: speed just above 10K pace so race effort feels controlled. Run on pace, not under. Nothing heavy in the gym after Wed 21 Oct. If HRV is sliding again, shorten to 4 reps rather than skip.
Provisional — Easy 7km. No heavy leg work from today.
Provisional — Easy 6km + 4 strides.
Provisional — Shakeout 30-35 min, easy, no strides. Check Puma Fast-R Nitro 3 and kit; Symbicort 20 min and salbutamol 15 min before the gun in the morning.

Provisional — STROUD 10K. ~16km all in: 3km warm-up with strides, 10K, 3km cool-down. Projection 37:20 flat, course cost ~15-25 s, target ~37:30, sub-38 the floor. Pacing is in the fixture notes: short downhill first km, do not follow the faster runner, expect the back-half drag and uphill finish. Puma Fast-R Nitro 3, nothing new on the day.
Provisional — Rest. No running the day after Stroud.
Provisional — Easy 8km, genuinely easy. Judge the legs on how they feel, not on pace.
Provisional — Easy 8km. Light gym only; nothing heavy lower-body this week unless the legs feel normal.
Provisional — Easy 7km + 4 strides, relaxed.
Provisional — Easy 6km.
Provisional — Shakeout 25-30 min, easy, no strides.

Provisional — GUY FAWKES 5 (8.05km): the experiment, raced on feel a week after Stroud. ~14km all in: 3km warm-up with strides, race, 3km cool-down. Record 29:12 (3:38/km) only if the legs say so; go out controlled. Pre-race meds as Stroud. Fission 20 entries open about now and sell out every year: enter if you want the March rehearsal.

athlete_response.thoughts: All fine, the only note is I did a slow 3k Warm down on sat, 5:30-5:40 pace but forgot to start the watch,
